method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a seat-neutral core (snap-core.l4, with six regulative rules for the duties of the State agency and the household) and a seat layer (snap-seat.l4) that restates no rule; no REFUSE (a day outside FY 2027 or a household outside the 48 States and DC answers `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: 7 U.S.C. chapter 51 (Food and Nutrition Act of 2008), OLRC USLM XML release point Public Law 119-121 (current through 9 October 2026), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/usc07-ch51.txt (includes Pub. L. 119-21 of 4 July 2025); with the USDA SNAP Cost-of-Living Adjustment tables for FY 2027 (1 October 2026 to 30 September 2027), 48 States and DC column, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/fna-snap-cola-fy2027.txt and recorded in ../../registers/annual-figures.json, encoded as a dated table

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run snap-core.l4 ; l4 run snap-seat.l4 ; l4 run snap-cases-applicant.l4
checks.result: 121 assertions satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings (2026-10-24); 7 #TRACEs with an expect line (6 breaches by the State agency, 1 obligation pending), each read and as expected
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the household applying for SNAP: s 2012(j), (m), (u)(2) (against the published table); s 2014(a) (categorical eligibility), (c) (gross and net income tests), (d) (income after exclusions as an input; the (d)(6) child support exclusion computed), (e)(1)-(6) (standard, earned income, dependent care, child support, excess medical and excess shelter deductions; the shelter cap and its elderly/disabled exception; the homeless shelter deduction), (g)(1) (resource limits); s 2014a; s 2015(d)(1)-(2) (work requirements, exemptions, periods of ineligibility); s 2015(o)(2), (3), (4) and (6) as facts, (5)(A) (the time limit); s 2017(a) (allotment), (c)(1) (first-month proration); s 2020(e)(2)(B)(iii), (e)(3), (e)(4), (e)(9), (e)(10) (the State agency's duties, as regulative rules). Out: item-by-item exclusions, standard utility allowance rules, sponsored aliens, s 2014(j), budgeting and reporting, students, alien eligibility, other disqualifications, E&T, s 2015(o)(5)(B)-(C), the rest of ss 2017 and 2020, retailers, enforcement, funding, Alaska, Hawaii, Guam and the Virgin Islands. Read with subjects/us/social-security-act/ (Title II, XVI, IV-A, XVIII amounts and statuses that are this encoding's inputs); cross-folder IMPORT is not possible.
seat: the individual applying for SNAP for their household
